hero.description: Highly customizable animated components & backgrounds that drop into your project and instantly make it stand out
hero.editHint: Drag or click values to edit

components.title: 130+ Components
components.desc: Backgrounds, text effects, animations, UI patterns. The stuff you'd build from scratch, already done.

organized.title: Well Organized
organized.desc: Four clear categories so you're not scrolling through a wall of unrelated stuff.

tech.title: TypeScript + Tailwind
tech.desc: Every component ships as a typed Vue 3 component styled with Tailwind. One stack, done right.

ai.title: AI-Ready
ai.desc: Works great with Cursor, Copilot, and v0. Describe what you need, drop it in, ship.

growing.title: Growing Fast
growing.desc: Vue's newest creative component library. Star us on GitHub to follow along.

quickStart.title: Get started in seconds
quickStart.hint: Use {installer1} or {installer2} — components land in your codebase, ready to use, instantly.

cta.headline: Stop building from scratch.
cta.description: Beautiful, animated Vue components you can drop into any project. Open source. Always free.

favorites.title: Favorites
favorites.emptyDescription: Tap the heart on any component to save it

components.Animations.AnimatedContent: Wrapper that animates any children on scroll or mount with configurable direction, distance, duration, easing and disappear options.
components.Animations.BlobCursor: Organic blob cursor that smoothly follows the pointer with inertia and elastic morphing.
components.Animations.ClickSpark: Creates particle spark bursts at click position.
components.Animations.Crosshair: Custom crosshair cursor with tracking, and link hover effects.
components.Animations.Cubes: 3D rotating cube cluster. Supports auto-rotation or hover interaction.
components.Animations.ElectricBorder: Jittery electric energy border with animated arcs, glow and adjustable intensity.
components.Animations.FadeContent: Simple directional fade / slide entrance / exit wrapper with threshold-based activation.
components.Animations.GlareHover: Adds a realistic moving glare highlight on hover over any element.
components.Animations.GradualBlur: Progressively un-blurs content based on scroll or trigger creating a cinematic reveal.
components.Animations.GhostCursor: Semi-transparent ghost cursor that smoothly follows the real cursor with a trailing effect.
components.Animations.ImageTrail: Cursor-based image trail with several built-in variants.
components.Animations.LogoLoop: Continuously looping marquee of brand or tech logos with seamless repeat and hover pause.
components.Animations.Magnet: Elements magnetically ease toward the cursor then settle back with spring physics.
components.Animations.MagnetLines: Animated field lines bend toward the cursor.
components.Animations.MetaBalls: Liquid metaball blobs that merge and separate with smooth implicit surface animation.
components.Animations.Strands: Glowing ribbon-like strands that ripple and weave across a transparent canvas.
components.Animations.MetallicPaint: Liquid metallic paint shader which can be applied to SVG elements.
components.Animations.Noise: Animated film grain / noise overlay adding subtle texture and motion.
components.Animations.PixelTrail: Pixelated cursor trail emitting fading squares with retro digital feel.
components.Animations.PixelTransition: Pixel dissolve transition for content reveal on hover.
components.Animations.Ribbons: Flowing responsive ribbons/cursor trail driven by physics and pointer motion.
components.Animations.ShapeBlur: Morphing blurred geometric shape. The effect occurs on hover.
components.Animations.SplashCursor: Liquid splash burst at cursor with curling ripples and waves.
components.Animations.StarBorder: Animated star / sparkle border orbiting content with twinkle pulses.
components.Animations.StickerPeel: Sticker corner lift + peel interaction using 3D transform and shadow depth.
components.Animations.TargetCursor: A cursor follow animation with 4 corners that lock onto targets.
components.Animations.LaserFlow: Dynamic laser light that flows onto a surface, customizable effect.
components.Animations.Antigravity: 3D antigravity particle field that repels from the cursor with smooth motion.
components.Animations.OrbitImages: SVG Path customizable orbiting images effect
components.Animations.MagicRings: Interactive magic rings effect with customizable parameters.
components.TextAnimations.AsciiText: Renders text with an animated ASCII background for a retro feel.
components.TextAnimations.BlurText: Text starts blurred then crisply resolves for a soft-focus reveal effect.
components.TextAnimations.CircularText: Layouts characters around a circle with optional rotation animation.
components.TextAnimations.CountUp: Animated number counter supporting formatting and decimals.
components.TextAnimations.CurvedLoop: Flowing looping text path along a customizable curve with drag interaction.
components.TextAnimations.DecryptedText: Hacker-style decryption cycling random glyphs until resolving to real text.
components.TextAnimations.FallingText: Characters fall with gravity + bounce creating a playful entrance.
components.TextAnimations.FuzzyText: Vibrating fuzzy text with controllable hover intensity.
components.TextAnimations.GlitchText: RGB split and distortion glitch effect with jitter effects.
components.TextAnimations.GradientText: Animated gradient sweep across live text with speed and color control.
components.TextAnimations.RotatingText: Cycles through multiple phrases with 3D rotate / flip transitions.
components.TextAnimations.ScrambleText: Detects cursor position and applies a distortion effect to text.
components.TextAnimations.ScrollFloat: Text gently floats / parallax shifts on scroll.
components.TextAnimations.ScrollReveal: Text gently unblurs and reveals on scroll.
components.TextAnimations.ScrollVelocity: Metallic sheen sweeps across text producing a reflective highlight.
components.TextAnimations.SplitText: Splits text into characters / words for staggered entrance animation.
components.TextAnimations.TextCursor: Make any text element follow your cursor, leaving a trail of copies behind it.
components.TextAnimations.TextPressure: Characters scale / warp interactively based on pointer pressure zone.
components.TextAnimations.TextType: Typewriter effect with blinking cursor and adjustable typing cadence.
components.TextAnimations.TrueFocus: Applies dynamic blur / clarity based over a series of words in order.
components.TextAnimations.VariableProximity: Letter styling changes continuously with pointer distance mapping.
components.TextAnimations.Shuffle: Animated text reveal where characters shuffle before settling.
components.Components.AnimatedList: List items enter with staggered motion variants for polished reveals.
components.Components.BounceCards: Cards bounce that bounce in on mount.
components.Components.BubbleMenu: Floating circular expanding menu with staggered item reveal.
components.Components.CardNav: Expandable navigation bar with card panels revealing nested links.
components.Components.CardSwap: Cards animate position swapping with smooth layout transitions.
components.Components.Carousel: Responsive carousel with touch gestures, looping and transitions.
components.Components.ChromaGrid: A responsive grid of grayscale tiles. Hovering the grid reaveals their colors.
components.Components.Counter: Flexible animated counter supporting increments + easing.
components.Components.DecayCard: Hover parallax effect that disintegrates the content of a card.
components.Components.Dock: macOS style magnifying dock with proximity scaling of icons.
components.Components.DomeGallery: Immersive 3D dome gallery projecting images on a hemispheric surface.
components.Components.ElasticSlider: Slider handle stretches elastically then snaps with spring physics.
components.Components.FlowingMenu: Liquid flowing active indicator glides between menu items.
components.Components.Folder: Interactive folder opens to reveal nested content smooth motion.
components.Components.GlassIcons: Icon set styled with frosted glass blur.
components.Components.GlassSurface: Advanced Apple-style glass surface with real-time distortion + lighting.
components.Components.GooeyNav: Navigation indicator morphs with gooey blob transitions between items.
components.Components.InfiniteMenu: Horizontally looping menu effect that scrolls endlessly with seamless wrap.
components.Components.MagicBento: Interactive bento grid tiles expand + animate with various options.
components.Components.Masonry: Responsive masonry layout with animated reflow + gaps optimization.
components.Components.PillNav: Minimal pill nav with sliding active highlight + smooth easing.
components.Components.PixelCard: Card content revealed through pixel expansion transition.
components.Components.ProfileCard: Animated profile card glare with 3D hover effect.
components.Components.ReflectiveCard: Metallic card with live webcam reflection and SVG displacement filter.
components.Components.ScrollStack: Overlapping card stack reveals on scroll with depth layering.
components.Components.SpotlightCard: Dynamic spotlight follows cursor casting gradient illumination.
components.Components.BorderGlow: Glowing mesh-gradient border that follows cursor direction and intensifies near edges.
components.Components.Stack: Layered stack with swipe animations, autoplay and smooth transitions.
components.Components.Stepper: Animated multi-step progress indicator with active state transitions.
components.Components.TiltedCard: 3D perspective tilt card reacting to pointer.
components.Components.StaggeredMenu: Menu with staggered item animations and smooth transitions on open/close.
components.Components.ModelViewer: Interactive 3D model viewer with orbit zoom, parallax, hover rotation and lighting presets.
components.Backgrounds.Balatro: The balatro shader, fully customizalbe and interactive.
components.Backgrounds.Ballpit: Physics ball pit simulation with bouncing colorful spheres.
components.Backgrounds.Beams: Crossing animated ribbons with customizable properties.
components.Backgrounds.ColorBends: Vibrant color bends with smooth flowing animation.
components.Backgrounds.DarkVeil: Subtle dark background with a smooth animation and postprocessing.
components.Backgrounds.DotField: Interactive dot grid with cursor bulge, glow, sparkle, and wave effects.
components.Backgrounds.DotGrid: Animated dot grid with cursor interactions.
components.Backgrounds.FaultyTerminal: Terminal CRT scanline squares effect with flicker + noise.
components.Backgrounds.Galaxy: Parallax realistic starfield with pointer interactions.
components.Backgrounds.GradientBlinds: Layered gradient blinds with spotlight and noise distortion.
components.Backgrounds.Lightfall: Colorful light streaks raining down a glowing tunnel with a cursor light.
components.Backgrounds.Ferrofluid: A churning magnetic fluid traced by glowing contour lines, with a cursor magnet.
components.Backgrounds.Grainient: Grainy gradient swirls with soft wave distortion.
components.Backgrounds.GridScan: Animated grid room 3D scan effect and cool interactions.
components.Backgrounds.GridDistortion: Warped grid mesh distorts smoothly reacting to cursor.
components.Backgrounds.GridMotion: Perspective moving grid lines based on cusror position.
components.Backgrounds.Hyperspeed: Animated lines continuously moving to simulate hyperspace travel on click hold.
components.Backgrounds.Iridescence: Slick iridescent shader with shifting waves.
components.Backgrounds.LightRays: Volumetric light rays/beams with customizable direction.
components.Backgrounds.Lightning: Procedural lightning bolts with branching and glow flicker.
components.Backgrounds.LineWaves: Animated line wave pattern with colorful warped distortion.
components.Backgrounds.EvilEye: Procedural evil eye shader with animated iris, slit pupil, and fiery outer glow.
components.Backgrounds.Radar: Radar sweep effect with concentric rings, radial spokes, and a rotating beam.
components.Backgrounds.SoftAurora: Soft aurora borealis shader with 3D Perlin noise and cosine gradient palettes.
components.Backgrounds.LiquidChrome: Liquid metallic chrome shader with flowing reflective surface.
components.Backgrounds.Orb: Floating energy orb with customizable hover effect.
components.Backgrounds.PixelBlast: Exploding pixel particle bursts with optional liquid postprocessing.
components.Backgrounds.Plasma: Organic plasma gradients swirl + morph with smooth turbulence.
components.Backgrounds.PlasmaWave: Raymarched plasma waves with dual-wave interference and OGL.
components.Backgrounds.Prism: Rotating prism with configurable intensity, size, and colors.
components.Backgrounds.PrismaticBurst: Burst of light rays with controllable color, distortion, amount.
components.Backgrounds.RippleGrid: A grid that continuously animates with a ripple effect.
components.Backgrounds.Silk: Smooth waves background with soft lighting.
components.Backgrounds.SideRays: Animated light rays emanating from the side with customizable colors and speed.
components.Backgrounds.ShapeGrid: Animated grid with shape variants (square, hexagon, circle, triangle) + direction customization.
components.Backgrounds.Threads: Animated pattern of lines forming a fabric-like motion.
components.Backgrounds.Waves: Layered lines that form smooth wave patterns with animation.
components.Backgrounds.LiquidEther: Interactive liquid shader with flowing distortion and customizable colors.
components.Backgrounds.FloatingLines: 3D floating lines that react to cursor movement.
components.Backgrounds.LightPillar: Vertical pillar of light with glow effects.
components.Backgrounds.PixelSnow: Falling pixelated snow effect with customizable density and speed.
